postToolUse.bash: if command -v cmake >/dev/null 2>&1 && ! cmake -P scripts/check_catch2_string_view.cmake >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '{"additionalContext": "Catch2 string_view guard FAILED. Run: cmake -P scripts/check_catch2_string_view.cmake to list the violations, then wrap each flagged std::string_view operand in static_cast<std::string> (see .github/instructions/cpp.instructions.md item 11)."}'; fi; exit 0
postToolUse.powershell: if (Get-Command cmake -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { cmake -P scripts/check_catch2_string_view.cmake *> $null; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { Write-Output '{"additionalContext": "Catch2 string_view guard FAILED. Run: cmake -P scripts/check_catch2_string_view.cmake to list the violations, then wrap each flagged std::string_view operand in static_cast<std::string> (see .github/instructions/cpp.instructions.md item 11)."}' } }
